Turn over C023, the 1918 iron 20 with the oak wreath. What words are on the other side?

Type record describes an imperial German Empire iron 20 pfennig dated 1918, but reference checks (Greysheet, NGC) list no imperial iron 20 pfennig: the imperial 20pf ended in 1877 (KM#5) and the WWI iron issues were 5pf (KM#19) and 10pf (KM#20) only. Iron 20pf pieces dated 1918 exist as municipal notgeld. Is this coin a city notgeld piece misfiled under the imperial issuer? Verify against the physical coin or photo.

Owner believes this is German. Photo side: 20 in an oak wreath, 1918, toothed border, iron, which fits a German city notgeld (emergency) 20 pfennig (the Empire struck no 1918 20 pfennig). Read the city name on the other side and re-file the type. Confirm at Phase 2 (pro photos); the owner's pen label may be wrong.
